description: Adds a ReVanced menu to the SoundCloud settings, styled like the app.
name: Settings

description: Unlocks level hints instantly without watching an ad: the share gate's watch ad action grants the hint immediately, with no ad playback required, even offline.
name: Aphelion Ad-Free Hint Unlock

description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check the game performs, so sideloaded installs pass and the forced Google Play Store redirect on launch is fixed.
name: Aphelion Installer Source Fix

description: App always behaves as if installed from Google Play, bypassing the install source check.
name: Bypass Google Play Install Check

description: All in-app purchases are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.
name: Dan The Man Free IAP

description: Adds libcurrencyhack.so to assets and helper dex.
name: Extreme Car Driving Add Native Lib

description: Sets all in-game currencies (diamonds, coins, upgrade points) to 999,999,999 via IL2CPP API.
name: Extreme Car Driving Unlimited Currencies

description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.
name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store

description: Rewarded ads pay out instantly: the engine is told a rewarded video is available and receives the started and completed callbacks straight away, so no video plays and every reward is granted offline.
name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards

description: Coins and gems are always set to 2,147,483,647 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased, or loaded from a save.
name: Hungry Shark Currency Hack

description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check in the game and its SDKs, so sideloaded installs are treated as store installs and installer-based Play Store redirects are bypassed.
name: Hungry Shark Installer Source Fix

description: Enables premium features by bypassing in-app purchase verification.
name: Premium

description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and unlocks all ball skins.
name: RB4 Premium & Skin Unlock

description: Every car reports as unlocked, so the whole garage is available right away no matter how the car would normally be earned.
name: Sling Drift All Cars Unlock

description: Every ad-gated reward works without watching an ad and without a network connection: continuing after a crash, free car unlocks, free upgrades, the end-of-race multiplier, bonus rubies and daily quest rerolls are granted instantly.
name: Sling Drift Instant Rewards

description: Rubies are pinned to 999,999,999 whenever they are earned, spent, purchased or loaded from a save, so the balance can never run out and every car stays affordable.
name: Sling Drift Unlimited Money

description: VIP status and the active subscription are always reported, so VIP cars and every VIP-gated feature stay available without Google Play billing.
name: Sling Drift VIP Unlock

description: Unlocks premium and all game modes without purchase.
name: Smash Hit Premium Unlock

description: Disables ads completely: EnableAD always returns false, interstitials and banners are no-ops, Adjust purchase verification is skipped.
name: Soccer Star Ad Removal

description: Rewarded and interstitial ad flows always report loaded and grant the success callback immediately without playing an ad, including offline.
name: Soccer Star Instant Rewarded

description: Unlocks VIP subscription permanently: ownership keys always report active and unsubscribe can never clear the flag.
name: Soccer Star VIP Unlock

description: Every in-app purchase package reports as purchased: the all weapons pack, all planets pack, remove ads and unlock levels and achievements stay permanently owned and unlocked, without contacting Google Play.
name: Solar Smash All Packages Purchased

description: Coins and keys always report 2,147,483,647 and every purchase is always affordable.
name: Subway Surfers Currency Hack

description: Coins, keys and shop items are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.
name: Subway Surfers Free IAP

description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts.
name: Block background-return feed refresh

description: Redirects matched Pigeon, default event-log and MQTT analytics addresses. Settings show which address kinds were patched. Other telemetry may remain.
name: Disable analytics

description: Videos in feed posts don't play by themselves as you scroll. Tap one to watch it full screen.
name: Disable video autoplay

description: Takes sponsored posts out of your Threads feed before they're shown.
name: Hide ads

description: Removes verified server cards suggesting accounts to follow. Ordinary posts, reposts and unknown card types stay.
name: Hide suggested users

description: Adds HushThreads settings to Threads. Long-press Threads' launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Threads' App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushThreads settings

description: Opens the web links you tap in your default browser instead of Threads' own, without Threads' click tracker. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads.
name: Open links in browser

description: Threads' dark mode uses pure black instead of its dark gray behind your feed, posts and profiles, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus and sheets keep their own grays.
name: Pure black dark mode

description: Stops Threads getting your phone's advertising ID from Google Play services. Threads gets a string of zeros in its place.
name: Remove the advertising ID

description: Lets Threads trust itself again on a re-signed build and share sign-in information with an Instagram installed with this build's own key. Both apps keep their current signing keys. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: Takes Threads' tracking tags, such as xmt, off the links you share or copy, and turns a short share link into the post's own link. The post a link opens stays the same.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description:
View stories without sending any information to the server. 
Your view will not appear in the story viewers list. 
Note: Since no data is sent, a story you have already viewed may appear as new on another device.
name: Anonymous story viewing

description: Replaces the domain name of shared links.
name: Change link sharing domain

options.description: The domain name to use when sharing links.
options.name: Domain name

description: Disables analytics that are sent periodically.
name: Disable analytics

description: Removes the auto-scroll toggle and prevents Reels from scrolling automatically.
name: Disable Reels auto-scroll

description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
name: Disable Reels scrolling

description: Disables the signature check that can cause the app to crash on startup. Using this patch may cause issues with sharing or opening external Instagram links.
name: Disable signature check

description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.
name: Disable story auto flipping

description: Disables swiping between the main navigation tabs and swiping to the camera. Tapping the tabs still works.
name: Disable swipe navigation

description: Adds a "Download" option to the post "..." menu to save photos and videos.
name: Download media

description:
Enables the developer menu, which can be found at the bottom of settings menu with name 'Internal Settings'.

It is recommended to use this patch with an alpha/beta Instagram release. Patching a stable release works, but the developer menu shows the developer flags as numbers and does not show a human readable description.
name: Enable developer menu

description: Unlocks the redesigned location sticker with additional style options.
name: Enable location sticker redesign

description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.
name: Hide explore feed

description: Hides the highlights tray in profile section.
name: Hide highlights tray

description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button.
name: Hide navigation buttons

options.description: Permanently hides the Home button. App starts at next available tab.
options.name: Hide Home

description: Hides Stories from the main page, by removing the buttons.
name: Hide Stories from Home

description: Hides suggested stories, reels, threads and survey from feed (Suggested posts will still be shown).
name: Hide suggested content

description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.
name: Limit feed to followed profiles

description: Changes links to always open in your external browser, instead of the in-app browser.
name: Open links externally

description: Removes the registration of screen capture callbacks, preventing Instagram from detecting screenshots or notifying the sender.
name: Prevent screenshot detection

description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.
name: Remove build expired popup

description: Removes the restriction of taking screenshots in disappearing messages and media that normally wouldn't allow it.
name: Remove screenshot restriction

description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on the pages Facebook blocks them on. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.
name: Allow screenshots

description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black, or a dark colour you pick, instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first.
name: AMOLED black theme

options.description: The colour dark mode's backgrounds take, as #RRGGBB. Cards and inputs take a lighter step of it. Leave it blank for black. A colour too light for Facebook's white text is refused.
options.title: Background colour

description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.
name: Block ad telemetry

description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background. That saves data and battery. The ads don't take up storage either.
name: Block background ad prefetch

description: Keeps your feed position when you return to Facebook within ten minutes, or for any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still work.
name: Block background-return feed refresh

description: Games you play in Facebook get no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none to show, so a rewarded ad gives no reward, and the game carries on.
name: Block Instant Games ads

description: Keeps the kinds of notification you pick off your phone, such as trending videos, memories and birthdays. Each kind has its own switch, and they all start off. Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions and login alerts always come through.
name: Block promotional notifications

description: Stops Facebook noticing when you take a screenshot or record the screen, in the feed, Reels, chats, games and everywhere else. Its switch starts on, under Privacy.
name: Block screenshot detection

description: Hides the Follow button on reels and the comment and reaction previews under them. Buttons such as Remix, Use template, Add yours and Stars go too, and each part has its own switch.
name: Clean up Reels

description: Opens comments in the order you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, Most relevant, Newest or All comments, instead of the one Facebook picks. An order you pick in a post's comments stays for that post, and links to a comment still open on it.
name: Default comment order

description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose in Hushfacebook's settings, such as Data saver or up to 720p, instead of the one Facebook picks as it plays. A quality you pick in a video's own menu still wins for that video.
name: Default playback quality

description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.
name: Disable Audience Network

description: Stops sending Facebook the list of reels you've watched. It's used to rank your Reels feed, and nobody else sees it. Reels you've already watched may come back in the feed.
name: Don't send reel watch history

description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.
name: Download any reel

description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.
name: Download any story

description: Adds Download to phone to the menu of videos in the feed and in Watch, below Facebook's own items. Videos save at the Download quality you set, best by default.
name: Download any video

description: Keeps Facebook in dark mode whatever its own setting says, for tablets where Facebook's settings have no Dark mode. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under Appearance and restart Facebook.
name: Force dark mode

description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from reels, feed posts and the comment sheet. The "Commission eligible" label stays.
name: Hide affiliate product links

description: Removes feed posts that Facebook's own detection marked as made with AI, and the reels and Watch videos it flagged the same way. A third switch also removes posts their creator labelled as AI, a fourth takes out the Meta AI cards Facebook adds between posts, and a fifth removes posts featuring Meta's AI characters. The Meta AI cards switch starts on. The others start off, so turn them on in Hushfacebook's settings.
name: Hide AI-detected posts

description: Hides the Upgrades and Also from Meta sections of Facebook's Menu. Each has its own switch. Settings, Help and support, your shortcuts and the rest of the Menu stay.
name: Hide Menu promotions

description: Removes the Meta AI answer and the Ask Meta AI prompts Facebook adds to search results, and stops search suggestions from opening Meta AI by themselves. People, groups, pages and posts stay, and the Meta AI button still works.
name: Hide Meta AI in search

description: Removes the row of Meta AI questions Facebook adds under some posts. The post, its link card and its buttons stay.
name: Hide Meta AI questions under posts

description: Removes the strip Facebook adds to some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less", who recently commented, or follow and chat suggestions, with no gap left behind. The post stays.
name: Hide post prompts

description: Hides feed posts whose text has a word or phrase you list, unless it also has one from your keep list. Hushfacebook never sends your words anywhere. The switch starts off, so turn it on and add words in Hushfacebook's settings.
name: Hide posts by words

description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from reels. The reel plays as usual.
name: Hide reel interest prompts

description: Removes the rows of reels between posts in the news feed, and the reels Facebook adds where your feed ends. A reel a friend posts stays.
name: Hide Reels in the feed

description: Removes the ads and boosted listings from Marketplace's feed and search results. The feed's request asks Facebook to leave them out and the requests that fetch only ads don't go out. Ads that come back among search results are taken out before Marketplace shows them, and a video ad that reaches the feed anyway isn't drawn. The listings people post stay.
name: Hide sponsored Marketplace listings

description: Removes sponsored and promoted posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.
name: Hide sponsored posts

description: Removes the ads between the posts on someone's profile or a Page. The profile's own posts stay.
name: Hide sponsored profile posts

description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.
name: Hide sponsored reels

description: Removes the ads from Facebook's search results, the sponsored posts and ad cards between the people, pages and posts you searched for.
name: Hide sponsored search results

description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.
name: Hide sponsored stories

description: Adds separate controls for the row of stories at the top of the news feed, Create story included, and the rows of stories Facebook puts between posts.
name: Hide Stories tray

description: Removes what Facebook adds to the feed besides ads: "Suggested for you" posts, "People you may know", suggested groups, "Stories you might like", "Pages you may like" and its own upsells. In-feed surveys go too, and so does the "People you may know" row on your own profile. Each kind has its own switch.
name: Hide suggested and promoted posts

description: Removes the stories Facebook suggests from people and Pages you don't follow, the ones marked Suggested in the Stories tray, and the tray's Find friends from contacts card. With Hide suggested and promoted posts in the build too, the tray's People you may know cards go as well. Your friends' stories, the Pages you follow and Create story stay.
name: Hide suggested stories

description: Takes the tabs you pick off the tab bar: Feeds, Friends, Marketplace, Groups, Gaming or Events. Each page stays in the Menu. Every switch starts off, and a change shows once Facebook restarts.
name: Hide tabs

description: Takes the title row and the All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages filters off the top of the Feeds tab, so it opens on its posts. Its switch starts off, so turn it on under News feed and restart Facebook.
name: Hide the Feeds header

description: Hides the "Get the Messenger app" card at the top of Chats while Messenger is installed. Facebook only counts a Messenger signed with its own key, so a re-signed Facebook shows the card even with Messenger right there. Without Messenger the card stays.
name: Hide the Get Messenger card

description: Takes the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video, off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and the reels in your feed still open. Facebook's own Hide in its tab bar settings keeps working, and a change to the switch shows once Facebook restarts.
name: Hide the Reels tab

description: Takes the new-item dot and count off the Reels tab, which some accounts call Video. Every other tab keeps its own.
name: Hide the Reels tab dot

description: Holding a reel plays it at double speed until you let go. The hold takes the place of Facebook's long-press menu, which the reel's more button still opens.
name: Hold a reel for 2x

description: Stops Facebook uploading its app analytics in the background and skips its on-device learning jobs. Its switch starts on, under Privacy. Restart Facebook after changing it.
name: Hold back analytics uploads
